actions.decision: UNDECIDED — Conditional on RCA2/RCA3 results. Near-white images are confirmed suboptimal but NOT yet proven as the primary bottleneck. Both policies (pretrained + finetuned) fail in white-image envs. This is CONSISTENT WITH multiple hypotheses: (a) white images ARE the bottleneck, (b) images are irrelevant and action/state mismatch is the bottleneck, OR (c) both contribute. Without a white-vs-colored A/B control, images cannot be ruled in or out as primary cause. P0b remains UNDECIDED, not CANCELLED. GUARDRAIL: If RCA2 (action) and RCA3 (state) show no misalignment, P0b must be re-elevated as the primary hypothesis for re-testing.
